items.body:
ALTERED STATE: A CONVERSATION BETWEEN AUTHOR MATTHEW COLLIN & JUSTIN TURFORD (TRUTH & LIES)
June 3, 2026

Movers presents an evening celebrating the reissue of Matthew Collin’s legendary book "Altered State: The Story of Ecstasy Culture and Acid House (Deep Cuts)" via White Rabbit. 

Join Justin Turford (DJ & Journalist) in conversation with Matthew Collin as together they trace the stories, politics and cultural shifts surrounding acid house, ecstasy culture and the underground scenes that changed Britain forever. 

Expect conversations, book signings and DJs taking things late into the night at Movers. FREE ENTRY!

Movers, 15 Hockley, Nottingham NG1 1FH

In EVENTS, MUSIC, INTERVIEWS
